verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents API credentials: personal access tokens and an OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Nothing in the evidence shows scopes, permission restrictions or least-privilege limits on those credentials, so it only establishes generic credential issuance, not the scoped capability the story asks for. Assistant delegation is a human-login feature and is adjacent, not credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
